passage_answers.actual: Divide each map by the square root of the mean of its squared grid values, its root mean square. This sets its sampled root mean square to one.
passage_answers.answer: The archived divisor is sqrt(mean(field**2)), not standard deviation after mean subtraction. For any nonzero array y, mean((y/sqrt(mean(y**2)))**2)=1. The generated nonzero continuous-noise arrays have positive RMS with probability one. The wording is correct for the described generated maps; no code listing promises behavior for an arbitrary zero array.
